_comment: Known-safe vulnerability exceptions for security audit CI.
_instructions: npm: add npm advisory source IDs (e.g. '1240992') or GHSA IDs — applied by scripts/npm_audit_gate.py to the `npm audit --json` report (npm itself has no --ignore flag)
pip: add CVE/GHSA IDs (e.g. 'CVE-2023-12345' or 'GHSA-xxxx-yyyy-zzzz') — matches pip-audit vuln IDs
Each entry MUST include a justification comment in the _justifications section

_justifications._example_npm_1234567: esbuild dev-only advisory, not exploitable in production build output
_justifications._example_CVE-2023-99999: affects feature X which we do not use; vendor patch not yet available
_justifications.GHSA-fc5q-39xc-vjpf: picomatch ReDoS through single-branch repeated extglobs (CWE-1333): every picomatch release is affected (range <=4.0.7, first_patched_version null per GitHub advisory API on 2026-11-18). Only reached via devDependencies (vite, vitest, tinyglobby; the tailwindcss@3 path is gone since the v4 migration) — `npm ls picomatch --omit=dev` is empty and `npm audit --omit=dev` reports 0 high. It only matches glob patterns from our own build/test config at build or dev time, never user input, and is not in the shipped bundle. Re-evaluate when picomatch ships a fix. Filed 2026-11-18; staging push audit has been red on this since 2026-11-18T02:05Z.
